_comment: How the History tab of the Lesson details colors what the backend reports (src-tauri/src/history.rs). Read by src/historyLooks.ts. event: a label and a Badge variant per event kind (the kinds of EventKind, camelCase); origin: a label and a Badge variant per origin of a write (learn, ingest, other); tone: the Badge variant of a chip by its tone (added, removed, neutral). Colors follow the previous Studio: created blue, revision pink, status and curation yellow, containers and amendment cyan, evidence and choice green, removed and unreadable red, the rest neutral. Adding an entry: key it by the backend's name and pick a Badge variant; src/historyLooks.ts checks at load that every kind, origin, and tone has one.
